Airfield Pavement Rehabilitation/Overlays 2. Runway/Taxiway Extension 3. Airfield Lighting and Navaids 4. Parallel and Connecting Taxiways 5. Property/Avigation Easement Acquisition 6. Safety Area Evaluation/Corrections 7. Environmental Studies 8. Drainage Improvements/Rehabilitations 9. Surveys 10. Roadway Improvements/ Relocations 11. Hangars/Terminal Building 12. Geotechnical Investigations 13. Fuel System Improvements 14. Security Fencing.
